dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is preparing for Festival Utsava. This festival will become a warm song for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: #Arasudraka wants to sing with Nara {NICKNAME} right now.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: #But Nara {NICKNAME} still needs to prepare for Festival Utsava with Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: If you feel tired, come listen to the Song Gatherers' song.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}, for letting me hear the song of Aramaha.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: I am getting closer to the Sourcesong, the homeland of songs.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: Golden Nara has to leave. Not happy. But more songs will be created, and the Sourcesong will be closer.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: The song that Golden Nara and Aranara sang at Festival Utsava is the brightest, most satisfying song I've ever heard, like the most plump pomegranate.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is the melody that is closest to the Sourcesong.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: I think the longer Golden Nara's journey, the closer the Sourcesong will be.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Golden Nara. I hope our songs will always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, I hope you have many difficulties in your adventure, and you overcome all of them. This way, you will create many stories, and the stories can become beautiful songs!
